name: io.github.Geo-Coder-17/coupon-swarm
title: coupon-swarm
description: Find, deposit and report public coupon codes in a shared CC0 ledger with found/expiry/verified dates.

environmentVariables.name: COUPON_SWARM_REPO
environmentVariables.description: owner/name of the ledger repo to read from and deposit into.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Fine-grained token with Issues: read and write on the ledger repo; only needed for deposit_code, deposit_batch and report_code. Leave unset for read-only use.
